title: mame_device
description: One row of the `mame_device` table. Keys and order follow schemas/schema.sql; NULL columns are omitted, never written as null (data-model.md §4.3).

mame_device.description: MAME device lookup key. The row's presence is what makes a device mapped or ignored.

chip_id.description: Set exactly when ignore_reason is absent.

ignore_reason.description: Set exactly when chip_id is absent, e.g. `screen`, `speaker`.

allOf.description: CHECK ((chip_id IS NULL) <> (ignore_reason IS NULL)): a device is mapped or explicitly ignored, never both, never neither.
